description: AUDIT: The LP-dual Δ_λ is SPARSE — only λ=(5,1) has Δ≠0. Δ_LP((5,1)) = -22.96, all others = 0. B = m_e × |0.190 × (-22.96)| = 2.22 MeV (matches AME exactly). The linking weight 5.85 = Δ_LP / (sgn×f) = -22.96/(-5) = 4.59 (concentrated on the highest-leverage partition). The sgn×f ansatz has the right SIGN but spreads weight across all partitions instead of concentrating on (5,1).

data.key_insight: Binding concentrates on the (5,1) partition — the standard rep twisted by one box.
